name: Benoit Saint Denis
photo_coverage: 14 photos: 3 embeddable from Commons (two CC0 by Gowdu59, 2024 and Apr 2026; one CC BY 3.0 YouTube frame, 2023) and 11 reference-only. Front: ESPN studio headshot (Jul 2026) and three pressers. Profile: UFC 329 faceoff (left side, Jul 2026) and UFC 322 faceoff (left side, Nov 2025). Body: two ESPN stance shots and two UFC 329 weigh-in frames. Stance: the Apr 2026 sparring photo is the only real fighting-stance reference in this whole set. Two more CC0 Commons photos (2018 military dress, 2019 BJJ) could not be downloaded because of rate limits and are older anyway.

face.shape: Long, rectangular face with a tall forehead, heavy brow and a strong lower face under the beard. Medium width; the cheeks are lean.
face.jaw: Wide and squared under the beard (the beard follows a square outline); the jaw angle sits low.
face.chin: Projects forward in profile; the beard adds length and a rounded-square outline.
face.cheekbones: Medium-high, moderately defined; lean cheeks above the beard line.
face.brow_ridge: Heavy and prominent; the eyes sit in shadow under it in almost every photo.
face.forehead: Tall and broad, with two or three deep horizontal creases and a slight backward slope in profile. Small red blemishes on the forehead in the Mar 2024 close-up.

eyes.shape: Almond, narrow opening with heavy upper lids; often narrowed in a hard stare.
eyes.colour: Light-to-medium brown, reading hazel in daylight (Mar 2024 close-up, 2023 interview).

eyebrows.shape: Low, straight and heavy, with the inner ends pulled down toward the nose (frown lines between them) and a slight lift at the outer third.
eyebrows.colour: Dark brown, close to the hair colour.

nose.width: Broad at the bridge and base.
nose.bridge: Broad, fairly straight; in the ESPN front view it looks slightly off-centre and flattened at mid-bridge, consistent with old damage.
nose.hump: Slight bump at mid-bridge in profile.
nose.tip: Rounded and fleshy, pointing slightly down.
nose.fight_damage: Likely: the broad, slightly uneven bridge. Model it symmetric but broad.

mouth.upper_lip: Thin, mostly hidden by the moustache.
mouth.resting_expression: Closed and pressed, corners turned down (a pout or scowl in studio and weigh-in shots); wide grin with crow's feet when relaxed.
mouth.teeth: Even upper teeth when smiling (2023 interview, Nov 2025 presser).

ears.protrusion: Stand out from the head because of their thickness.
ears.cauliflower_ear: Yes, pronounced on both sides: thick, rounded, lumpy pinnae with the inner folds filled in (ESPN headshot both ears; Mar 2024 close-up, left ear).
ears.notes: One of his strongest recognition cues; both ears should look swollen and smooth-lumpy rather than folded.

face.notable_marks_scars: A thin pale vertical line on the left cheek beside the nose in the ESPN headshot may be a small scar (low confidence; not clear in other photos). A pale horizontal scar line about 8-10 cm long runs below the right collarbone (ESPN headshot and stance-left). Fresh cuts near the left brow in the Jul 2026 presser are temporary.

hair.style: Short tapered cut: sides and back faded short (about 0.5-1 cm), top about 4-5 cm, swept back and up with some volume at the front. In the Mar 2024 photo it is cropped shorter all over (about 2 cm).
hair.colour: Very dark brown, near black; slightly warmer brown in daylight.
hair.hairline: Receding at both temples (M shape) with a defined central forelock; dense on top.

facial_hair.colour: Very dark brown, near black; a few warmer brown hairs in the moustache and cheeks in daylight.
facial_hair.density: Dense and even over the chin, jaw, moustache and lower cheeks; slightly thinner at the upper cheek line.
facial_hair.length_mm: About 20-30 mm at the chin, 10-15 mm on the cheeks (2025-2026). Shorter, about 10-15 mm, in Mar 2024.
facial_hair.shape: Full beard joined to a thick moustache, trimmed to a squared-off, slightly rounded bottom edge. Cheek line fairly high and natural, about level with the middle of the nose; neck line under the jaw.

skin.tone_note: tone_hex uses the studio and daylight samples. The Mar 2024 hotel photo is dim tungsten light and much darker; the Jul 2026 presser is flash-blown (#fbcdb8) and was not used.
skin.undertone: Warm, light olive to light tan.
skin.freckles_marks: Small red blemishes on the forehead in close-ups; the right-collarbone scar line. Dense dark body hair on the chest, forearms and legs.

body.build: Muscular, dense lightweight frame of average height (180 cm, 185 cm reach): broad shoulders, thick chest and arms, narrow waist.
body.body_fat_notes: Lean with clear abs and obliques in the ESPN stance shots and the Jul 2026 weigh-in; the most muscular of these four fighters.
body.chest: Full, well-developed pecs with dark chest hair.
body.arms: Thick upper arms and forearms, visible veins.
body.waist: Narrow relative to the shoulders; a pronounced V.
body.posture: Upright, chest out, chin slightly raised or held level in a hard stare; leans the head back a little in faceoffs.
body.notable_physique_traits: Heavy beard and brow, cauliflower ears, broad V-shaped muscular torso, two tattoos (left pec, right inner arm).

fight_stance.observed: Apr 2026 sparring photo: southpaw, right foot and right hand forward. Feet roughly 1.3-1.5 shoulder widths apart, lead foot pointing at the opponent, rear foot turned out, knees bent with weight fairly even. Torso bladed about 30-45 degrees. High, tight guard: both gloves at chin to eye height, the lead hand held about a forearm's length in front of the face, the rear (left) glove tucked against the left cheek, elbows down and in, chin tucked.
fight_stance.modelling_note: Mirror the default orthodox guard for him (right side leading). Keep both gloves high and the elbows close to the ribs.

tattoos.description: Round design: a red cross pattée (arms flaring at the ends) with a black outline in the centre, ringed by a band of black lettering (not legible at these resolutions).

tattoos.where: Right upper arm, inner/front side over the biceps
tattoos.description: Round emblem with a thick black outer ring, red fill and a black silhouette motif in the centre (not legible; could be an animal or an insignia).

tattoos_note: Confirmed sides: the chest piece is on his LEFT pec (the Nov 2025 faceoff shows his left side with it), the emblem on his RIGHT inner arm (viewer's left in the front-on ESPN stance-right shot). No other tattoos on the chest, abdomen, forearms or legs in these photos; his back is not clearly shown.
accessories_seen: Gold chain with a small pendant at the Jul 2026 weigh-in; string/beaded bracelet on the right wrist; steel watch on the left wrist at pressers. French flag over the shoulders at weigh-ins and faceoffs.

kit.typical_shorts: UFC-issued black shorts with the tonal grey wave pattern; one version has a blue SAINT DENIS wordmark running down his left thigh (ESPN, Jan 2026) and the other the crypto.com logo low on his right leg. Sparring kit: black and gold Venum.
kit.shorts_colours_note: Region samples from the ESPN stance PNG (median and 75th percentile).
kit.walkout: French flag. Mar 2024: black and teal UFC walkout jersey.

morphs_not_in_embed._note: Ear targets from assets/embed/mh-shapes-x.bin.gz (not in mh-manifest.json). Heavy cauliflower on both ears: scale-depth thickens, flap pushes off the head. No morph makes the lumpy surface; add it with a normal map. l-/r- are his own left and right.

notes: Confidence: high for hair, beard, brows, ears, tattoos, build and stance; medium for nose and face proportions; low-to-medium for morph values. 14 photos (3 embeddable), with good 2026 coverage and two profiles. What to watch: (1) Recognition cues: dense near-black full beard trimmed square at the bottom, heavy low brows pulled down at the inner ends over deep-set brown eyes, tall creased forehead with receding temples, and heavy cauliflower ears on both sides. (2) Expression at rest is a scowl or pout with the mouth corners down. (3) Muscular V-shaped torso, the most muscular of these four; dark body hair. (4) Tattoos: red cross pattée in a lettered ring on the LEFT pec, round red-and-black emblem on the RIGHT inner upper arm. Mirror-check both. (5) Southpaw with a high, tight guard (Apr 2026 sparring photo). (6) Skin is warm light olive; avoid the dark hotel-light samples. Macro values: ageOldM = (30-25)/65; heightUpM 0.04 from 2*(1.803-1.785)/0.875.
